operations.name: David Mathews

expected.charges: Conspiracy against the American cause (the alleged “Hickey Plot”) — arrested as the Loyalist Mayor of New York City in 1776.

operations.research_note: Litchfield Centennial Celebration (1876), pp.33-35 reproduces Mathews August12, August20/22 and September26,1776 letters and Trumbull custody order. Custody included residence under keeper and guarded permitted walks, not solely jail. ArrestJune21 in local history vs June22 in modern scholarship: monthJune only. Seymour notice Connecticut Journal Nov27,1776 reproduced by RevWarTalk: escape night after20th; record monthNovember only, no unverified exact day. December2 letter reports arrival NewYork after escape, not discharge. Existing schema release_date denotes end of restraint including escape. Public biography erroneous1777 escape year flagged for later minimal factual correction; no biography rewrite or note additions. Calendar-month duration5, not invented day count.
